div.div:
1. Staff pool requires MFA; authorize, threshold change and revocation need a sign-in under 10 min old.
2. Field pool has no MFA by design: phone-bound app, encrypted outbox, own farms or trips only.
3. Public lookup returns origin, processing dates, status and drying variables only.
4. One KMS key per data class; no function or person holds the restricted key.
5. No IAM users or static keys: people use Identity Center, CI uses OIDC, devices use X.509.
6. Colors group paths by identity kind; every arrow is an allowed path.
